package.description: Xperia Companion offers an easy way to perform a software repair.

en-US.description: Xperia Companion offers an easy way to perform a software repair.
en-US.longDescription:
Software repair will reset your device and reinstall the system software. This can be useful if you experience severe problems with your device.
Software repair will erase all user data on your device. Files on the external storage (SD™ card) will not be deleted.
You may need to unlock your device using your Google™ account if theft protection is enabled. Please make sure you know your Google™ account details before you start a software repair.
The software will be downloaded to your computer and, once the download is complete, the device can be repaired. A step-by-step guide will take you through the whole process.
It is strongly recommended to keep your computer plugged into a power source while repairing.
Your device should be connected to the computer during the repair.
You will not be able to use your phone during the repair, not even for emergency calls.
en-US.name: Sony Xperia Companion

zh-CN.description: Xperia Companion 提供了一种执行软件修复的简单方法。
zh-CN.longDescription:
软件修复将重设您的设备并重新安装系统软件。如果您的设备遇到严重问题，这将会非常有用。
软件修复将清除设备上的所有用户数据，但不会删除外部存储设备（SD 卡）上的文件。
如果启用防盗保护，您可能需要使用 Google 帐户解锁设备。在启动软件修复之前，请确保知道 Google 帐户详细信息。
软件将会下载到您的计算机，下载完成之后，将对设备进行修复。分步指南将引导您完成整个过程。
强烈建议您在修复时将计算机插上电源。
修复期间，应将您的设备连接到计算机。
修复期间，您将无法使用设备，即使有紧急电话。
